premises.text: High-performance computing requires significant time and resources to deploy applications across cloud instances
premises.evidence_span: teams of people that will spend months deploying software and writing tools and technologies to make hundreds or thousands of cloud instances work together

premises.text: Developers can distribute high-performance applications across any cloud at scale in minutes
premises.evidence_span: we allow any developer the opportunity to distribute virtually any high-performance or high-throughput application across any cloud at any scale in a matter of minutes, not months

premises.text: A single virtual instance can be automatically distributed across multiple compute nodes
premises.evidence_span: we take that instance, and we automatically distribute it and replicate it across hundreds or thousands of compute nodes in the cloud

premises.text: High-performance computing is a significant and growing market
premises.evidence_span: high-performance computing is already a $29 billion industry. And of that, a billion is already being spent in the cloud today

premises.text: Platform as a service is a rapidly growing sector of the cloud
premises.evidence_span: the platform as a service is one of the fastest-growing sectors of the cloud with over 25% annual growth projected each year for the foreseeable future

premises.text: Public beta allows users to quickly set up and run applications in the cloud
premises.evidence_span: CPU usage is in public beta. You can go to www.cpusage.com right now. And in a matter of a few minutes, you can be up and running at scale in the cloud

value.text: Users can efficiently utilize cloud computing resources without extensive setup
value.evidence_span: you should be able to plug in any compute application, consume as much compute power as you want, without having to think about configuration

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships coded.
